name: Markdown to PDF
author: Claw Machine
description: Convert Markdown files to beautifully formatted PDFs using Pandoc, XeLaTeX, and Mermaid CLI. Renders Mermaid diagrams (pie, bar, xychart, flowchart, etc.) as embedded PNG images via headless Chrome. Full pipeline: mermaid render → pandoc → xelatex → PDF. Wrapper at /tmp/md2pdf takes input.md output.pdf.
